Pins compare_fields(ds,ds,metric='l2')==0.0 exactly — catches any regression that introduces numerical jitter in the same-grid no-op path (must be bit-exact, not rtol-tolerant).

Pins linf recovers the exact uniform offset 0.5 (atol=1e-12) — catches a regression where the aligned grids get a non-trivial interpolation weight that smears the offset.

Pins compare_fields == align_grids + l2_relative_error byte-exact (rtol=1e-12) — catches a regression where compare_fields takes a shortcut that diverges from the documented 'align + diagnostic' contract.
Pins metric='rmse' raises ValueError with 'metric' in message — catches a regression that silently treats unknown metrics as linear interpolation or falls back to l2.
Pins units='normalized' raises ValueError with 'units' in message — catches a regression that silently treats unknown unit strings as 'si' (the default) and masks typos.

Pins linf(si) == linf(code) * si_factor(b_field) (rtol=1e-12) — catches a regression where units='si' applies in_si() twice or not at all on the linf path.

Pins the transform_to alias-forwarding regression on the report path — catches a regression where _align_frames drops aliases= before resolution.
Same claim as TestCompareFields variant but on the report entry point — guards that the normalisation-equality check isn't bypassed by field_comparison_report's batching loop.
Same-grid method validation on the report path — catches a regression where the no-op regrid shortcut bypasses method= validation on report but not compare_fields.

Structural invariant case: compare_fields = align_grids + pure diagnostic (8x8 vs 5x5, upsampling direction).

Exercises the full species-lookup path for omega_pe with reduced mass ratio m_e=1/256 against a hand-computed value; guards wrong-species selection / mass-reference regressions.
Guards the sibling ion branch of the species selector; a bug that hardcoded electrons would pass omega_pe but fail omega_ci.

Guards r_i = v_th_i / omega_ci dependency chain — a dropped cyclotron sign or species index would fail here.

Pins div_B of uniform B = 0 (div-B cleaning sanity). Regression if divergence stencil is broken on uniform input.

Verifies c_s recipe actually reads PhysicsParams.gamma rather than a module-level default — key regression when needs_gamma is forgotten on a new recipe.

div_B factor = b_field_ref / length_ref — non-identity inputs would miss a dropped-metric bug that happened to cancel for identity.

ln(1/1) = 0 sanity — catches a wrong-log-base or sign regression in entropy formula.

Alias n_e -> n_s0 must resolve through compute_field dependency graph, not just FieldDataset __getitem__; guards a partial alias registration.
Direct FieldDataset __getitem__ alias path, distinct from the compute alias; together with previous test this covers both code paths.
Gyrotropic entropy uses P_par*P_perp^2/n^5 with species-specific tensors; guards a regression where s_gyro_i falls back to fluid P_par/P_perp.

ux/uy/uz -> u1/u2/u3 alias for relativistic PIC (see conventions.md § 8.1); guards the letter-alias registration for four-velocity components.
